model: The map user button and the mypage action button faded their colors for the default 150ms. The mypage button also blurred the page behind a background that is already 95% opaque. The color change is one frame and the blur is gone.

noise.rule: 9 is round(150ms * 60 / 1000). 60 is one layer at 60fps while the mypage button is visible. The map button has no blur. Not a sampled compositor trace.
